backend/main.mo: Actor implementing access-controlled user profiles and full cricket match model with match creation validation including toss info.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping chase‑related features to frontend files and components with test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing all major frontend components, pages, hooks, and offline logic.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark theme CSS variables and applying layout defaults.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes and wraps the app with ThemeProvider, layout, and error boundary.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary displaying a fallback UI and allowing reset to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Responsive header showing branding, connectivity, home navigation, and login/logout via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, main content container, and footer for all pages.
frontend/src/components/BackendCanisterI: Provides an info dialog explaining backend canisters, offline mode, and backend unavailability.
frontend/src/components/ConnectivityStat: Displays online/offline status with reason badges and links to backend canister info.
frontend/src/components/DeleteMatchConfi: Confirmation dialog for deleting a match, indicating whether deletion affects backend or local data only.
frontend/src/components/live/BatterRoleS: Select component allowing users to choose a batter from a player list.
frontend/src/components/live/NextBatterD: Dialog for selecting the next batter or showing an all-out message.
frontend/src/components/live/NextBowlerD: Dialog for choosing the next bowler with validation if none is selected.
frontend/src/components/mobile/MobileSaf: Wrapper for dialog content optimized for mobile-safe scrollable layouts.
Scrollable mobile-safe wrapper for select dropdown content.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Dialog prompting the user to enter and save their name during profile setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useConnectivity.ts: Tracks device network status and backend availability to determine online/offline state and reasons.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity auth, handling login, identity loading, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalMatchIntegrit: Checks local match storage integrity and returns status, corruption info, and a retry trigger.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles and matches, supporting offline behavior and local storage fallback.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollIntoViewOnFo: Scrolls a referenced element into view when it receives focus.
frontend/src/hooks/useUnsavedOfflineChan: Warns users before leaving a page when unsynced offline changes exist and provides a confirmation helper.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus custom CSS variables, dark mode values, and mobile layout tweaks.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/offline/localMatchStore.ts: Implements localStorage-based match persistence with IDs, load/save utilities, integrity checks, and error handling.
Provides structured offline error logging and user-friendly storage-related error messages.
frontend/src/offline/serialization.ts: Defines BigInt-safe JSON serialization/deserialization for matches, teams, players, innings, and balls for offline storage.
frontend/src/pages/InningsSummaryPage.ts: Displays a summary of the latest innings, handling match loading states and computing basic batting stats.
frontend/src/pages/LiveScoringPage.tsx: Provides the live scoring UI with ball recording, batter/bowler selection, extras handling, and chase/innings logic.
Lists stored matches with create, view, retry, and delete actions, including offline and integrity checks.
frontend/src/pages/MatchSetupPage.tsx: Handles match creation with team setup, player entry, overs validation, and toss selection before starting an innings.
frontend/src/pages/MatchStatsPage.tsx: Loads a match and displays per‑innings batting and bowling statistics with error and empty‑state handling.
frontend/src/pages/MatchSummaryPage.tsx: Displays a full match summary, handling loading/error states, computing innings stats, and showing results once both innings are complete.
frontend/src/utils/chase.ts: Provides helper functions to compute chase targets, remaining runs, result sentences, and wickets remaining.
frontend/src/utils/formatTossInfo.ts: Formats match toss data into a readable sentence or indicates missing toss info.
frontend/src/utils/inningsCompletion.ts: Calculates legal deliveries, checks if an innings has reached its overs limit, and computes current overs and balls.
frontend/src/utils/inningsEligibility.ts: Determines which batters are out and filters eligible batters for selection, including next-batter logic.
frontend/src/utils/matchStats.ts: Computes detailed batting and bowling statistics from innings ball data.
frontend/src/utils/parseMatchId.ts: Parses and validates a match ID string into a bigint, returning errors for invalid IDs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage support and hash routing handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, animations, container settings, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state describing an offline-first cricket scoring app, including features, architectural notes, and a list of known issues affecting scoring, mobile behavior, and offline mode.
